Evidence snapshot 25 October 2026, 01:43 UTC. These are deterministic implementation rules, not calibrated physiological thresholds or a measurement of rep-count accuracy. RepCounter requires confidence>=0.6 and a complete top-bottom-top cycle, resets on gaps>0.75s or nonmonotonic time, uses0.15s zone stability and accepts0.6–15s cycle duration. CoachingPolicy compares a new valid rep with at least five prior valid durations using mean+max(sampleSD,0.25s). Reported discomfort has an exercise-independent stop decision, including manual reps and holds. PR #64 passed 23 native checks, 26 core checks and a Watch simulator build; fake playback does not establish audible acceptance. Stop identity persists across ticks; repeated stop does not cut itself off or replay after background return. Lifecycle invalidation prevents old cues/sensor callbacks entering a new state.
